parameters.name: N_TRACES
parameters.help: Number of traces to process at one time; use number of traces per ensemble for pre-stack.

parameters.name: T_START
parameters.help: This is the minimum time which will be used in the analysis.

parameters.name: T_END
parameters.help: This is the maximum time which will be used in the analysis.  If zero (0.0), the maximum time of input data will be used.

parameters.name: XSPACING
parameters.help: Distance between input traces, default to 0.0 for value from global parameters.  Check View in flow (job.output) for value used.

parameters.name: CONFIG
parameters.help: Choose one of four display configurations.

parameters.name: K0CENTER
parameters.prompt: Position of zero wavenumber in display
parameters.help: Zero wavenumber may be positioned on left or in center of display.

choices.label: CENTER
choices.help: Zero wavenumber (K=0) will be in center of display.

choices.label: LEFT
choices.help: Zero wavenumber (K=0) will be on left side.

parameters.name: F0BOTTOM
parameters.prompt: Position of zero frequency in display:
parameters.help: Zero frequency may be positioned at top or bottom of display.

choices.label: BOTTOM
choices.help: Zero frequency (K=0) will be at bottom of display.

choices.label: TOP
choices.help: Zero frequency (F=0) will be at top of display.

parameters.name: DBSCALE
parameters.prompt: Plot FK,TK,TX panels in DB or Linear:
parameters.help: Amplitudes of FK, TK, TX data panels may be plotted using either a Linear or dB (logarithmic) scale.

parameters.name: TXPCTGAN
parameters.help: Gain is set as a percentile of the input trace amplitudes, ( 90 to 100).

parameters.name: FKGAINMX
parameters.help: Upper limit for color scale when displaying FK data.

parameters.name: FKGAINMN
parameters.help: Lower limit for color scale when displaying FK data.

parameters.name: XFLATPCT
parameters.help: The offsets may be tapered prior to K-space transform to minimize FFT edge effects (100.0 = no ramping).

parameters.name: TFLATPCT
parameters.help: The traces may be tapered prior to the frequency transform to minimize FFT edge effects (100.0 = no ramping).

parameters.name: OLDTABLE
parameters.prompt: Edit OLD polygon table or create NEW one?
parameters.help:
The polygon table specifies the regions to keep or reject
using FK filters. Create a new one or modify an old one.

parameters.name: FKPTABLE
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a polygon (mute) parameter file description from the parameter file menu.

parameters.name: NEWTABLE
parameters.help: Type in the name a new table to be created for polygon storage.

parameters.name: PASS
parameters.help: F-K filter can either pass or reject the specified F-K regions.

parameters.name: PCTFLAT
parameters.prompt: Percent flat for F-K filter windowing
parameters.help: The F-K filter may be ramped (in T-X) to control the smoothness of the filter.

parameters.name: NWINT
parameters.help: The F-K filter is transformed to T-X domain and windowed.  This will be the time extent of the filter.

parameters.name: NWINX
parameters.help: The F-K filter is transformed to T-X domain and windowed.  This will be the spatial extent of the filter.

parameters.name: program
parameters.help:
Type path name of program executable.  If the path doesn't start wi
th a /, the main ProMAX executable directory is used.

parameters.name: DEBUG
parameters.help:
To debug program, enter YES.  You will have to debug the program yo
urself
